# Missing list and image conversion methods after code reorganization While working with the markdownify library, I noticed that several HTML elements are no longer being properly converted to Markdown. This appears to be a regression that affects lists, images, and horizontal rules. ## Description I was using markdownify to convert some HTML content to Markdown and noticed that certain elements weren't being converted properly: 1. Lists (`
    `, `
      `, `
    1. `) are not being converted at all 2. Images (``) are not being converted to Markdown image syntax 3. Horizontal rules (`
      `) are not being rendered It seems like some conversion methods are missing from the `MarkdownConverter` class. When I look at the code, I can see that methods like `convert_img`, `convert_hr`, `convert_list`, `convert_ul`, `convert_ol`, and `convert_li` are not present, even though they're being referenced in tests. ## Steps to reproduce Here's a simple example that demonstrates the issue: ```python from markdownify import markdownify # Lists don't convert html = "
